papas-donuteria.summary: Papa's Donuteria puts you in charge of preparing doughnuts for customers. Read each order, prepare the doughnuts, and match the requested toppings.
papas-donuteria.how_to: Check the customer's order before preparing ingredients. Use the mouse to select items and drag ingredients while you work through the order.
tips: Finish the current preparation step before moving to the next station.
Compare the topping choices with the order before serving.

tiny-clash.summary: Tiny Clash is an army-building strategy game. Buy units, merge matching troops into stronger units, then send the army into an automatic battle.
tiny-clash.how_to: Buy units, drag identical troops together on the grid to merge them, then select FIGHT to start the battle.
tips: Check that two units have the same type and level before trying to merge them.
Use earned coins to strengthen the army before retrying a battle.

classic-sudoku.summary: Classic Sudoku is a number-placement puzzle. Fill the grid so each row, column, and 3-by-3 box contains the digits 1 through 9 without repetition.
classic-sudoku.how_to: Select an empty cell and choose a number that does not already appear in its row, column, or 3-by-3 box.
tips: Look for rows, columns, or boxes with only one missing number.
Check the crossing row and column before committing to a number.

chrome-dino.summary: Dinosaur Game is an endless runner starring a pixel dinosaur. Jump over obstacles and duck when needed to keep the run going.
chrome-dino.how_to: Press Space or the Up arrow to jump. Use the Down arrow to duck while watching for the next obstacle.
tips: Time jumps around the next obstacle rather than pressing repeatedly.
Watch the space ahead as the run speeds up.

dinosaur-game.summary: Dinosaur Game is a browser runner built around avoiding obstacles. Keep the dinosaur moving by timing jumps as hazards approach.
dinosaur-game.how_to: Check the start screen for the jump control, then time jumps to clear the obstacles in front of the dinosaur.
tips: Leave enough space to land before the next jump.
Use short attempts to learn the distance needed to clear each obstacle.

geometr-jump.summary: Geometry Jump is a precision platform game about moving between pillars. Choose short or long jumps while avoiding the saw blade.
geometr-jump.how_to: Use the short and long jump options shown by the game to move between pillars without touching the saw blade.
tips: Choose the jump distance to fit the gap ahead.
Wait until the route past the saw blade is clear before jumping.
